headline: PPC: EBITDA profits of €1.8 billion, investments of €2.6 billion and expansion into new European markets
summary: Greek utility PPC reported EBITDA of €1.8 billion and investments of €2.6 billion. Renewable energy output rose 63% to 8.3 TWh, and the company is expanding into new European markets.
why: Public Power Corporation is Greece's largest electricity producer and a major player in renewables, so its results indicate the health of the Greek and southeast European power sector.
